verdict.rationale: The SDK can pause a run on tool-approval interruptions and resume later from the same RunState. Sessions persist conversation history across runs, and sandbox sessions are described as resumable. A community report, however, frames crash-durable execution as coming from a separate Temporal-based version, which points to an extra tool rather than built-in crash recovery. Missing for 10: documented automatic checkpointing of in-flight runs, explicit RunState serialization to durable storage, evidence of resuming after a process crash or restart without an external orchestrator, and hands-on corroboration.
